AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Demon Slayer Trainee
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was taken on as a child by a former Hashira, drilled in footwork, breathing control, and the fundamentals of swordsmanship before most children had learned to read.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Orphaned by Demons
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents were killed by demons when [PAWN_pronoun] was very young. Taken in by the Corps, [PAWN_pronoun] grew up on grief and determination in equal measure.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mountain Hermit Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up alone in the high mountains, learning to hunt, build shelter, and survive encounters with wild animals long before [PAWN_pronoun] ever met another person.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Wisteria Village Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in one of the hidden wisteria villages that shelter Demon Slayers. From infancy [PAWN_pronoun] knew the smell of wisteria, the names of the Hashira, and why the nights must be feared.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Swordsmith's Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into the Swordsmith Village and began working the bellows and polishing blades before [PAWN_possessive] tenth birthday. The sound of hammer on steel was a lullaby.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Beast Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] clawed [PAWN_possessive] way to the rank of Hashira through sheer feral instinct. [PAWN_pronoun] fights like something not quite human, dual blades moving in patterns no formal school ever taught.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Flame Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The title of Flame Hashira is a birthright — and a burden. [PAWN_nameDef] carries both with unyielding resolve, the roaring intensity of [PAWN_possessive] blade matched only by the warmth [PAWN_pronoun] shows those under [PAWN_possessive] protection.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Water Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] embodies the adaptability of water — calm and yielding until the moment of strike. As Hashira, [PAWN_pronoun] mentors many, fights without ego, and endures without breaking.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Thunder Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] moves faster than the eye can follow. [PAWN_possessive] Thunder Breathing reduces every fight to a single, impossible instant — blink and you've already lost. The anxiety that drives [PAWN_pronoun] is also what makes [PAWN_pronoun] unstoppable.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Flower Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s technique looks like a dance and ends like a guillotine. Every strike is precise, graceful, and final. Behind the elegance lives a grief [PAWN_pronoun] has never allowed [PAWN_possessive] to share.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Stone Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is immovable. No demon has ever knocked [PAWN_pronoun] off [PAWN_possessive] feet, and most have stopped trying. Stone Breathing demands absolute physical dominance — [PAWN_pronoun] has spent a lifetime delivering it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Wind Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a storm given a human shape — unpredictable, relentless, and as likely to insult [PAWN_possessive] allies as [PAWN_possessive] enemies. [PAWN_possessive] Wind Breathing is brutally effective, which [PAWN_pronoun] considers sufficient justification for everything else.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Insect Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] cannot behead a demon with raw strength — so [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't try. Instead [PAWN_possessive] blade carries a wisteria-derived poison that paralyses from the inside. [PAWN_pronoun] explains this with a smile that never quite reaches [PAWN_possessive] eyes.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Love Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] fights with everything [PAWN_pronoun] has — which turns out to be considerable. Loud, affectionate, and frighteningly skilled, [PAWN_pronoun] developed Love Breathing from scratch and would be delighted to tell you how, at length, right now.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Sound Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a shinobi before [PAWN_pronoun] was a Hashira. [PAWN_possessive] Sound Breathing turns every fight into a performance — explosions, misdirection, and five blades at once. The theatrics are intentional. So is every kill.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mist Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] passes through a battle like fog — present, lethal, and then simply gone. [PAWN_possessive] Mist Breathing confounds enemies who cannot track something that seems to exist everywhere and nowhere at once.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Serpent Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s blade moves in coiling, winding patterns that slip past any guard. [PAWN_pronoun] is difficult to like and impossible to predict — a combination that has served [PAWN_pronoun] well against demons and colleagues alike.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Forest Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] fights as the forest does — with patience, with roots, and with an overwhelming weight that eventually smothers everything beneath it. [PAWN_pronoun] tends [PAWN_possessive] wisteria grove and [PAWN_possessive] sword with equal care.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Frost Breathing Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is still and silent before the strike, like a frozen lake — and just as dangerous to trust. [PAWN_possessive] Frost Breathing trades speed for precision, landing cuts of surgical exactness that demons rarely survive long enough to describe.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mizunoto Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] only recently survived the Final Selection. The certification is fresh, the sword is new, and the demons ahead are not yet real in [PAWN_possessive] mind. That will change quickly.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mizunoe Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: A handful of missions survived, a handful of demons slain. [PAWN_nameDef] has stopped flinching at the sound of screaming and started noticing patterns in how demons move at night.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Tsuchinoeto Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has earned [PAWN_possessive] third rank through consistent results and, perhaps more importantly, consistent survival. [PAWN_pronoun] has begun to understand that talent alone does not keep you alive.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Tsuchinoene Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Reaching the fourth rank required [PAWN_nameDef] to kill demons that would have killed [PAWN_pronoun] a year ago. [PAWN_pronoun] carries the names of the slayers who died beside [PAWN_pronoun] on the road to this rank.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kanoto Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a middle-ranked slayer of solid ability and proven nerve. [PAWN_pronoun] has stopped counting kills and started counting the people [PAWN_pronoun] has managed to protect.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kanoe Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The sixth rank is where many slayers spend their careers — capable enough to survive, skilled enough to be trusted with independent missions. [PAWN_nameDef] has earned that trust, repeatedly.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Hinoto Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] operates at a level that most slayers never reach. [PAWN_possessive] breathing technique is deeply refined and [PAWN_pronoun] has fought demons that carry centuries of hatred — and walked away.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Hinoe Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Two ranks below Hashira, [PAWN_nameDef] is a slayer of exceptional ability. Corps command trusts [PAWN_pronoun] with the most dangerous solo assignments. The gap between [PAWN_pronoun] and the Hashira is real — but [PAWN_pronoun] is closing it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Tsuchinoto Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The second-highest non-Hashira rank. [PAWN_nameDef] is spoken of in Corps circles as a future Pillar. [PAWN_pronoun] does not disagree, but has learned to say nothing until the blade has spoken first.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kinoe Demon Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The highest rank below Hashira. [PAWN_nameDef] has effectively mastered [PAWN_possessive] breathing style and defeated demons that would overwhelm most of the Corps. The only thing standing between [PAWN_pronoun] and a Hashira title is a vacant seat — or the death of whoever currently holds it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Former Hashira
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The rank was stripped by injury or choice, not by failure. [PAWN_nameDef] carries the knowledge and the scars of a Hashira's career and has quietly accepted that the hardest battles are behind [PAWN_pronoun]. [PAWN_pronoun] spends the peace writing down everything [PAWN_pronoun] learned.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Retired Slayer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Most slayers die young. [PAWN_nameDef] did not. [PAWN_pronoun] retired after a career of quiet competence and now lives proof that consistency outlasts heroics. [PAWN_pronoun] is reluctant to talk about [PAWN_possessive] service, but [PAWN_possessive] hands still move to reach for a sword that is no longer there.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kakushi
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the unsung members of the Corps — a Kakushi who arrives after every battle to tend the wounded, clean the blood, and carry the ones who cannot walk. [PAWN_pronoun] has dragged more slayers back from the brink than any demon has ever sent forward.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Swordsmith
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has never fought a demon, yet [PAWN_possessive] work has killed hundreds of them. A dedicated swordsmith of the village, [PAWN_pronoun] pours everything into blades that will hold a nichirin edge under the worst conditions imaginable.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Demon Slayer Corps Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] passed the Final Selection, received [PAWN_possessive] nichirin blade, and has been hunting demons ever since. [PAWN_possessive] rank is unspecified — [PAWN_pronoun] tends not to mention it. The work speaks for itself.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Corps Crow Handler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] raises, trains, and interprets the messenger crows that carry orders between the Corps and its scattered slayers. [PAWN_pronoun] knows every bird by name and voice, and a bird trained by [PAWN_pronoun] has never failed to deliver its message.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Corps Intelligence Officer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] works in the shadows behind the Corps' battles — compiling reports on demon activity, mapping movement patterns, and building the intelligence that keeps slayers alive. [PAWN_pronoun] has never held a sword in combat, but [PAWN_possessive] work has saved more lives than most who have.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Wisteria Farmer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] tends the wisteria fields that protect the hidden villages from demon incursion. The work is quiet, unglamorous, and vital. [PAWN_pronoun] has never seen a demon — the wisteria ensures that — and intends to keep it that way.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Wisteria Village Elder
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has overseen a wisteria-protected village for decades, coordinating rest, resupply, and recovery for slayers passing through. [PAWN_pronoun] has heard enough stories to know exactly how bad things are, and [PAWN_pronoun] has chosen to keep smiling anyway.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Traveling Medicine Seller
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] travels the roads between towns carrying medicines, tonics, and the kind of knowledge that only comes from treating injuries in the field with no surgeon nearby. [PAWN_pronoun] asks no questions about wounds and charges nothing to those who cannot pay.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Nichirin Ore Miner
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years working the high-altitude mines that supply the special ore for nichirin blades. The work is dangerous, the air is thin, and the material is irreplaceable. [PAWN_pronoun] takes every seam personally.
